hook: Why did Anthropic just spend eleven billion dollars on edge CPUs?
spoken_script: Why did Anthropic just spend eleven billion dollars on edge CPUs? Anthropic signed an eleven-point-six billion dollar agreement with Akamai. Instead of relying solely on massive GPU data centers, they are deploying autonomous agents across four thousand edge locations. Heavy reasoning stays on GPUs, but agent memory and tool calls run locally under fifteen milliseconds. It is not replacing AWS or Google Cloud—it is powering distributed agent swarms.
